claim: A game that redraws incrementally (erase by tile redraw, draw by OR or overwrite) needs no staging or commit: set one sprite per object at its plot and hide it at its erase and at every screen clear.

evidence.text: Sprites 0-4 hens, 5 duck, 6 player; five hook sites at the screen clears hide sprites 0-6 and replay the displaced instruction.
